i.norm: Verifies that computing covariance of a single-column matrix returns a 1x1 matrix with the correct variance value (using biased estimator since biasCorrected=false). Input: two observations [1] and [2] with one variable. The biased variance = mean((x - mean)^2) = ((1-1.5)^2 + (2-1.5)^2) / 2 = 0.25
